conventions.electricalS: two-port, both reference impedances 50 ohm; independent of actual RT
conventions.loadedReflection: input reflection at 50 ohm reference with actual RT
conventions.rc: lumped series junction pair for total active length; not electrode S11
conventions.eo: mean junction voltage in optical frame / its 0.001 GHz value; not electrical S21
conventions.transfer: static equal-arm linear phase model; electrode differential voltage, fixed optical loss
conventions.source: open-circuit Vpp; source resistance separate from 50 ohm S-parameter reference
